scope: Approved native macOS FolioNotes scope; deferred modules/platforms remain gated
method: Subjective weighted planning estimate; not verified security/correctness, percentage of code, or a release certificate.

areas.area: Mac integration, security review and release evidence

last_completed: Owner confirmed on a rebuild at 9f5096f: 'seems to be working just fine. nav works, those vertical text things are hidden.' The two defects Increment 13 set out to fix -- controls disappearing on resize, and character-by-character vertical text -- are both absent in a running app, and section navigation works from both the toolbar and the sidebar. The layout work is no longer unverified source: it has been built, launched and checked by hand.
current_work: Finish the pre-UI checklist rather than starting new features, since the owner has now confirmed the UI is usable. Three things are unexercised because they changed after the last rebuild: the capture panel's phantom cancellation message, File > Open Recent, and the relabelled Jump to Cursor control. Then re-walk the regression set that Increment 13 could have broken (create, edit, save, reopen, search) and, with the UI stable, move to the live microphone and speech testing that has been deliberately held back.
